title: Auditing LLM Pseudo-Label Distillation for Review Informativeness at E-Commerce Scale
abstract: arXiv:2611.13797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study hard-label distillation from Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite to compact encoders on 5.34 million Turkish marketplace reviews. A strict new-SKU temporal test measures teacher fidelity; a separate, teacher-label-blind audit by one company annotator measures editorial agreement. An H3 category prefix slightly improves teacher fidelity on the full new-SKU test. On the 16,000-review chronological audit subset, it instead reduces agreement with both Gemini and the annotator, with a clearer paired difference for CORN than for cross entropy. Thus the context effect depends on the evaluation population, and teacher fidelity alone does not establish editorial alignment. Under the measured offline configurations, a single-L4 student pipeline processes reviews 50.2 times faster than the teacher pipeline.

translated_title: 电商规模下针对评论信息量的LLM伪标签蒸馏审计
translated_abstract: 我们在534万条土耳其电商评论上研究了从Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite到紧凑编码器的硬标签蒸馏。研究使用严格的新SKU时间测试来衡量教师模型保真度；并由一位公司标注员进行独立的、对教师标签盲的审计，以衡量编辑一致性。H3类别前缀在完整的新SKU测试上略微提升了教师保真度。但在16,000条评论的时间顺序审计子集上，它反而降低了与Gemini和标注员的一致性，其中CORN的配对差异比交叉熵更为明显。因此，上下文效应取决于评估人群，仅凭教师保真度并不能确立编辑对齐。在所测量的离线配置下，单个L4学生模型流水线处理评论的速度比教师流水线快50.2倍。
tldr: 本研究审计了电商规模下LLM伪标签蒸馏的质量，发现类别前缀虽能提升教师保真度却降低人工编辑一致性，表明教师保真度不能等同于编辑对齐，且学生模型流水线处理速度比教师快50.2倍。
en_tdlr: This study audits LLM pseudo-label distillation for review informativeness at e-commerce scale, finding that a category prefix improves teacher fidelity but reduces human editorial agreement—showing teacher fidelity alone does not establish editorial alignment—while the student pipeline processes reviews 50.2x faster than the teacher.
